STRESS.NAME: Stress Module
STRESS.DESCRIPTION: The Stress Module is designed to help users identify, understand, and manage the causes of their daily stress, whether academic, work-related, family-related, or emotional.

SELF.NAME: Self-Esteem Module
SELF.DESCRIPTION: The Self-Esteem Module focuses on strengthening users' self-perception. It helps develop self-worth, reduce self-criticism, and foster a more compassionate relationship with oneself.

INTERPERSONAL.NAME: Interpersonal Module
INTERPERSONAL.DESCRIPTION: The Interpersonal Module focuses on improving the quality of the user's relationships: romantic, family, friendships, and work. It provides tools to relate with empathy and security.

STORIES.NAME: Stories Module
STORIES.DESCRIPTION: The Stories Module offers a collection of narratives that help users reflect on their experiences and emotions, providing insights and comfort through shared stories.

TIPS.NAME: Tips Module
TIPS.DESCRIPTION: The Tips Module provides practical advice and strategies for everyday challenges, helping users improve their mental health and emotional well-being.

0.title: Too much on your mind?
0.body: Take a deep breath. You don’t have to fix everything today. Start by caring for yourself.

1.title: You are not your worst thoughts.
1.body: Sometimes the voice in your head can be harsh. But those thoughts don’t define your worth. Let’s challenge that inner critic together—tap here for a gentle journaling prompt to reframe it with kindness.

2.title: Tonight, make rest your priority.
2.body: You’ve done enough. Let go of today’s weight and allow yourself the rest you deserve. We’ve prepared soft ocean sounds and gentle breathing to help you sleep better.

3.title: You didn’t sleep well last night
3.body: Try a sleep story and some relaxing sounds tonight.

4.title: It’s okay to feel hurt. It’s okay to take space.
4.body: When a conversation leaves you feeling heavy, the best thing you can do is pause. Let’s process what happened, step by step—without judgment.

5.title: The world can wait. Your peace can’t.
5.body: Silence the notifications. Close your eyes. Inhale for 4... exhale for 6. Let’s start small, right here.

6.title: You’ve been under pressure lately. I see it.
6.body: Let’s acknowledge how much you’ve been carrying. You don’t have to do this alone. I’m here.

selfEsteem.TITLE: Self-Esteem Module
selfEsteem.REC1: This article provides strategies such as recognizing your strengths, challenging negative thoughts, stepping out of your comfort zone.
selfEsteem.REC2: Proposes key steps like self-care, avoiding negative thoughts, speaking to yourself respectfully, and staying close to supportive people.
selfEsteem.REC3: This article helps you identify situations that hurt your self-esteem, recognize negative self-talk, and replace it with more positive, realistic thoughts.
selfEsteem.REC4: Covers habits like positive thinking, setting realistic goals, avoiding comparison, taking care of your health, and practicing self-forgiveness.

interpersonal.TITLE: Interpersonal Module
interpersonal.REC1: This article explains the importance of clear communication in relationships, how to listen actively, and how to express needs.
interpersonal.REC2: This article explores strategies for building stronger, healthier interpersonal relationships through empathy, trust-building, and boundary-setting.
interpersonal.REC3: This article offers insights into how to manage conflicts effectively within relationships, emphasizing understanding, compromise, and problem-solving.
interpersonal.REC4: This article discusses how emotional intelligence (EQ) affects interpersonal relationships and offers tips for improving EQ to foster better connections.
